displaySampling: Each cloud's published one-parsec voxels are sorted by a stable coordinate hash and the first ceil(N/4) are retained. Runtime LOD uses prefixes of that spatially distributed sample.
notes: The published source FITS files remain available from https://dataverse.harvard.edu/api/access/datafile/<dataverseFileId>. Generated overlay data is checked in under src/data/overlays/molecular-clouds.
